properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.7 is a real transitive dependency resolved in yarn.lock (pulled via the elliptic/Ethereum chain used by @magic-sdk/admin). It ships SHA-1, SHA-224/256/384/512 implementations, so SHA-1 in particular is available to anything that reaches for the library. No first-party file imports hash.js directly — the asset is availability in the shipped dependency tree; the deterministic dep_scan is the only thing that could see it. Changeable here by dropping the dependency chain or pinning a rep

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge@1.3.1 is a transitive dependency of selfsigned@2.0.1 (dev HTTPS cert generation for the webpack/next dev toolchain). It ships RSA keygen/encrypt/sign, AES, X.509 handling and a TLS implementation. No first-party call site found — availability asset; quantum-unsafe RSA available to the dev toolchain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/curves@1.4.0 is a transitive dependency (via the @web3-storage/@ucanto chain declared by packages/api). Provides Ed25519, secp256k1, P-256, X25519 and more. Distinct package from the direct @noble/ed25519 dependency (object ALG-5e08bdf5, scout 2) — not the same logical asset. No first-party import of @noble/curves itself found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 is a transitive dependency (Ethereum-style chain, e.g. via @magic-sdk/admin). Provides ECDSA over secp256k1/P-256/P-384 and ECDH. No first-party application import found; the algorithms ship with the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES implementations (CBC/CTR/GCM and legacy modes) ship inside node-forge@1.3.1, the transitive dep pulled via selfsigned for dev HTTPS. No application call site; availability of AES in the shipped library, including legacy modes the library still exports.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@3.1.2 is a transitive dependency (crypto-browserify-style polyfill chain). Provides PBKDF2-HMAC (SHA-1/256/512 via node's crypto or JS fallback). No first-party call site found; iteration parameters are decided inside the dependent libraries, not in first-party code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/hashes@1.1.2 is a transitive dependency via the @ucanto/@web3-storage stack that packages/api depends on; the UCAN libraries use it for multihash/digest computation. No direct first-party import; first-party code hashes via multiformats instead (reported separately).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BLAKE3 is available via @noble/hashes@1.1.2 (transitive dep). No first-party call site found; the hash is PQ-safe and its presence is purely an availability fact about the shipped tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js@3.0.1 is a transitive dependency (via @magic-sdk/admin's Ethereum-style keystore chain). scrypt is a memory-hard password KDF; no first-party call site, so its cost parameters are set inside the dependent library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: selfsigned@2.0.1 generates self-signed X.509 certificates (via node-forge RSA) for local dev HTTPS in the webpack/next toolchain. PKI object: these certs are dev-only trust anchors, generated on the fly, not committed. Changeable here only by swapping the dev-server toolchain.
